provenance.note: A wordless sung syllable over the formant pad's body: notes keep the pitch asked for; a mouth opening, a delayed vibrato and breath shape the syllable, and the composer supplies the phrase's entrances and endings. Its own numbers — the envelope, the mouth's walk, the breath, the vibrato, its detune and width over the body, the tilt of its source, its sends — were its note controls' defaults and literals in its module; the body (vowels, formants, lid) is the room's `formantPad` block, which the formant pad's row owns.

notes.sourceTilt: Null is the plain sawtooth, which no tilt is; a phrase writes one (1 to 3) for a smoother source.
notes.sustain: The fraction a held syllable keeps; the timbre's hold is read off it.
notes.timbres: Its loudness is MEASURED by the gate every kitchen voice is held to (tools/test-voices.ts --bless): the voice alone on its fixture's melody through the real graph, both engines, both rates, less its table's level. It was typed as -12 while the voice waited for a fixture and read four decibels quieter when it got one (the engine review of 09-22, finding 5). The brightness is the mouth's default opening, the formant body's own corner.
notes.cost: MEASURED by tools/budget.ts --bless: 25 nodes a note and 46.6x the reference a minute on its fixture.
